text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone located on the south side of Woodward Avenue, between a point 53.5 metres east of Uphill Avenue and a point 12 metres further east.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone operating at all times, on the south side of Woodward Avenue, between a point 53.5 metres east of Uphill Avenue and a point 12 metres further east.
